# Maria & Nell Harcourt

- [Maria](../character/maria.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — sent a marriage gift and good wishes together · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit Tabby's Place and successfully arrange to rent the cottage from Miss Tabby Linden and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Later that night, [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) visits their room and enthusiastically begs to join them as a housemate, to which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) agree pending Mabel's consent.
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Tabby’s Place

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

> [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) writes a letter to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) describing her stay at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). She recounts her health scares, introduces the eccentric older boarders, and shares her growing admiration and feelings for [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) [Hale](../character/ezra.md), an earnest young theology student.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIV Enter Ezra

_Sources: [v3 ch.Ezra P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Ezra P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002), [v3 ch.Ezra P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Ezra P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

> Miss Winifred and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat over the newspaper obituaries and past parish stories, including a story about an overzealous evangelist named [Fiske](../character/fiske.md). [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) mourns the death of her loyal old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), refusing Nell's offer of a replacement for now. After spending [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh return to [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), where Captain Saul shares news from [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) about his upcoming book publication.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS
